Passage: An applicant for a licence must pay the application fee before the Authority considers the application.
Licence holders pay an annual fee by 31 January each year.
A licence may be withdrawn if the annual fee is not paid within 30 days of the due date.
Virtual asset custodians must keep client assets segregated from their own assets.
A custodian must reconcile client virtual asset holdings at least once each business day, as required by Rule 4.1.3.
